guard_pose: feral crouched brawling stance facing right, knees bent, both fists raised, a wild grin

jab: fast claw jab: snaps the front hand straight forward with the fingers hooked like claws, then pulls it back into the stance
jab2: clawing cross: rakes the rear hand forward in a hooked claw swipe with a twist of the hips, then back into the stance
jab3: brutal front kick: lifts the front knee and kicks straight forward at belly height with a flash of cyan claw marks, then back into the stance
utilt: rising claw: swings one clawed hand in a big arc from low in front straight up above his head, cyan streaks following the fingers, then back into the stance
dashattack: pouncing tackle: lunges forward like a panther, shoulder first, with a burst of cyan spiritual energy, then slides to a stop and stands back up in the fighting stance
fsmash: charged claw strike: coils far back with one hand pulled behind him, then lunges forward and rakes the clawed hand ahead at full extension leaving five short cyan claw streaks, then recovers into the stance
usmash: upward smash: crouches, then springs up on his toes and rakes both clawed hands straight upward above his head with a burst of cyan spiritual energy, then lands back in the stance
dsmash: low split kicks: drops low and kicks fast in front at foot level, then spins and kicks behind him, cyan claw streaks flashing, then back into the stance
nair: neutral aerial: curls and spins in mid-air like a cat with a swirl of cyan claw slashes close around his body, then opens up again
fair: forward aerial: a powerful flying kick straight forward in mid-air with a flash of cyan claw marks, then pulls the leg back in
dair: down aerial: stomps straight down beneath him with both feet in mid-air with a burst of cyan spiritual energy, then pulls the legs back up

nspecial: Cero: thrusts his open right palm forward, a red sphere of spiritual energy swells in front of his hand, then fires as a crimson blast forward with a recoil of his arm, then he returns to the stance
sspecial: Desgarron: draws his right hand back as long claws of cyan spiritual energy extend from his fingertips, then rakes it forward in a big swipe that sends five cyan claw blades tearing straight ahead, then returns to the stance
uspecial: clawed rising strike: springs upward with a vicious rising claw swipe, his hand trailing cyan claw marks above his head, ending in mid-air with the arm raised and the legs hanging
dspecial: Garra de la Pantera: crosses his forearms in front of his chest, then flings both arms forward and a volley of five sharp white bone darts shoots out from his forearms with cyan trails, then he returns to the stance
ultimate: Gran Rey Cero: raises his clawed right hand, a drop of his own blood falls into a sphere of blue spiritual energy gathering in front of his palm, it swells and spins, then he thrusts the palm forward and a thick blue-white beam blasts straight forward, then he returns to the stance
w0_sspecial: Pantera charge: draws his katana Pantera with its teal grip from his hip and dashes forward thrusting it straight ahead, cyan spiritual energy streaming off the blade, then slides to a stop and lowers the sword back into the stance
w0_ultimate: Grind, Pantera: holds up his katana and rakes the fingers of his other hand along the blade, the sword dissolves into a howling swirl of cyan spiritual energy around him, his hair grows long down his back, panther ears, a tail, white bone armour and claws form on him, he roars as a ring of cyan energy blasts outward close around him, then the burst settles and he returns to the stance
w1_sspecial: giant Desgarron: long blazing claws of cyan spiritual energy grow from his fingers, he draws the hand back then rakes it forward and five big cyan claw blades tear straight ahead of him, then he returns to the stance
w1_ultimate: Desgarron: blazing cyan claws of spiritual energy extend from both hands, he lunges forward and rakes again and again with fast alternating claw swipes, then raises both arms and slashes down with both hands at once, ten long cyan claws of light tearing forward, then he returns to the stance

notes: makeGrimmjow: buildBrawlerNormals(S=1.04, P=1.08, fx=Claw) -> jab3 exists. baseWeapon Pantera (katana) is only worn at his side: no move outside w0 uses Limb::Weapon and the guard picture shows no sword, hence armed 'fists'. Overrides turn the hand moves into claw swipes and colour the Claw energy cyan; ftilt/dtilt/bair/uair stay the generic kicks. Specials: nspecial red Cero projectile at f16/44 (Point); sspecial Desgarron claws at f12/46 (piercing, rehit, explodes; Throw); uspecial rises f4 (vy -17.4), hits f4-14/44, helpless -> pin None; dspecial 5 PanteraDarts at f18/48 (Cast). w0 'Pantera (zanpakuto)' replaces sspecial (katana rush: dash f10 speed 14, hit f10-22/46), jab (exists) and ultimate (KISHIRE, PANTERA: awaken burst f38-44, Pantera form 12 s whose dspecial fires 7 darts and sspecial is the giant Desgarron). w1 'Griffes de Pantera' replaces sspecial (giant Desgarron), jab (exists) and ultimate (DESGARRON: teleports to the foe f34, 5 rakes from f43, ten claws of light f72-78/100). Base ultimate GRAN REY CERO: beam f46-78/100 (230 px wide); written blue as in the anime and as the game's Claw colour. GUARD14 says 'fists raised like claws': the picture shows closed fists. Source inconsistencies: Desgarron and Garra de la Pantera are Resurreccion (Pantera) techniques in Bleach but are his base specials here; 'Kishire, Pantera' is written 'Grind, Pantera' (the English release command).
